font.reason: High-contrast editorial serif (variable 400-700) is the closest Persian match for the Didot/Bodoni newsroom voice required by the source prompt; sans would lose the editorial character. Used at weight 500, size 150 (116 Latin) with 160px line boxes.

comps.translatedSummary: Computer -> کامپیوتر (constant line 1); verbs researches/builds/codes -> پژوهش می‌کند / می‌سازد / کد می‌نویسد relay in place on line 2. Cards are text-free wireframes.

rtlDecisions.why: The evidence column precedes the argument in reading order, so it takes the start (right) side.
Moved to the left half, text start-aligned (right edge x=790), keeping the 84px gap to the cards like the original; vertical centre kept at y=540 (top=540-160, two 160px lines).

rtlDecisions.what: Wireframe pages inside cards (flex order, marginLeft auto, borderLeft/paddingLeft, textAlign, MRI sidebars)
rtlDecisions.why: Pages are drawn as Persian RTL pages via direction:rtl and logical properties; MRI viewer sidebars swap sides; random draw order and seeds untouched.

rtlDecisions.what: MRI scan image with marker circles and radial gradient
rtlDecisions.why: Physical imagery, symmetric gradient; mirroring an image is not reading-direction meaning.

rtlDecisions.what: Vertical step scroll, ease-in-out step windows (f14/62/108), word relay cross-fade and grey timing, shadows, seeds
rtlDecisions.why: Up/down motion and timing are not reading-direction; the step-and-click design intent is preserved.
Still whole-word opacity/colour cross-fade (no per-letter motion so joining is safe); letterSpacing removed (0); weight 500 single serif family.

rasterTextHandling: No raster assets; cards are CSS shapes with no text.
concerns: Registry duration is 16 frames (inline); the design runs ~145 frames, verified with --duration 150 and the full video rendered at 150 frames. The upstream original render only has 16 frames so orig comparison exists only for early frames.
Wireframe pages are mockups; with real screenshots, Persian pages would need real RTL screenshots.
lessons: Registry-inline durations may be tiny (16 f) and the original render then only covers those frames: orig comparison is impossible beyond them; rely on the design length from the source prompt plus --duration.
